current_snapshot_note: Comparative findings describe the original audit snapshot. The role-state overlay below was corrected after the v0.62.13 archive seal to match its 35/5/31 capsule snapshot; immutable v0.62.13 release assets retain the earlier 33/7/29 index. The course capsules are the authority for that release's role counts.

post_audit_updates.course_capsule: A seven-layer open course capsule now projects all 40 roles into canonical JSONL plus JSON, schema, manifest, deterministic validation, and a human-facing learner/educator/interop viewer while preserving owner-native backends.
post_audit_updates.learner_delivery: The learner application now consumes a dedicated learner-delivery sidecar for format badges, verified offline packages, and the one-file offline curriculum navigator.
post_audit_updates.current_manager_overlay: The v0.62.13 capsule snapshot contains 35 published roles and 5 roles still in production, through 31 distinct edition DOI records. The earlier 33/7/29 comparative index and audited 29/11, 28/12, and frozen 21/19 counts remain historical snapshots.
post_audit_updates.c20_publication_truth: C20 is reconciled as a completed 241-page public edition at Zenodo record 22172396 and family release U429.

a00_learner_runtime.function: Filter exercises by module, category, and explicit-solution availability, then open exact verified owner-reader anchors.

methodology.design_premise: Independent native backend designs were intentional and are being compared for synthesis.
methodology.comparison_policy: Scores are omitted where false precision would hide scope differences. Size, schema validation, or manager admission alone does not establish learner usefulness.
methodology.mutation_boundary: Read-only audit; no owner, manager, repository, publication, or access state was mutated.

central_hub_behavior: ingest current owner release receipts automatically
never present planned unit routes as public

audit_snapshot_global_defects: Central owner truth is 29 published / 11 unpublished while overlay truth is 28 / 12 and frozen-model truth is 21 / 19.
Only 19 of 28 published roles have explicit HTML.
A public clone cannot replay all adapters without external owner/logbook roots.

audit_snapshot_manager_synthesis.a00_status: Separate legacy proof despite the live HTML labeling all four packages as 2.3.1.

resolved_audit_snapshot_items: The central capsule snapshot reconciles the role-state split to 35 published and 5 in production after D30, D40, and the Lebl-family completion updates.
C20 is reconciled to its completed public edition.
A00 now has a contract-2.3.1 successor adapter instead of a legacy-only label.
The learner application consumes validated learner-delivery and learner-tool sidecars.
The course-capsule layer exposes the readable A00 learner tool without exposing raw JSON as a learner action.
open_successor_gaps: Twenty-eight native implementation families do not yet have a public-replay-complete contract-2.3.1 adapter.
Learner consumption of capsule capabilities remains partial outside current delivery actions and A00 assessments.
Every accepted adapter must remain reproducible from public bytes without private owner or logbook roots.
Native-family limitations documented by the audit remain visible until their own evidence closes them.

source_evidence.scope_note: This model uses only the named audit entry. Facts not stated there are explicitly marked as not established or not reported.

families.core_pattern: Locale-neutral and locale-variant curriculum graph with 519678 records, a curated 35-concept/76-prerequisite DAG, exact evidence mappings, and a SQLite query layer.
demonstrated_strengths: Best pedagogical graph in the comparison.
limitations: Extremely heavy: 1.84 GB plus a 1.13-GB SQLite database.
families.learner_runtime_status: No proven live consumer.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not established in the audited entry; deterministic two-build identity is established.

families.core_pattern: Append-only 452387-record translation/control history with UUIDv5 identity, explicit missing-solution states, and lossless JSONL/CSV.
limitations: Primarily structural rather than a learner-route graph.
families.learner_runtime_status: No learner runtime use is reported; the model is described as structural rather than learner-route oriented.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Lossless JSONL/CSV exchange is established.

families.core_pattern: Strict module projections with fixed-point selection, isolated two-build candidates, and fail-closed cursor-last admission/recovery.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not established; projections exist, but export lag and three overlay dialects fragment consumption.

families.core_pattern: Consumer-specific JSON, JSONL, and CSV views sharing bilingual segment identity.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Pragmatic exchange is established; exact reversibility is not explicitly proved.

families.core_pattern: Exercise-closure packet over a strict graph with statement, hint, answer, and solution subtrees, rights, and deterministic roundtrip.
families.learner_runtime_status: No runtime consumer exists.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Deterministic roundtrip is established.

families.core_pattern: Source-bound incremental registry using native IDs, direct-text hashes, declared topology deltas, marker-bound LaTeX variants, and fail-closed drift checks.
demonstrated_strengths: Used in real production and release.
families.learner_runtime_status: No learner backend consumer.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not explicitly established; source binding and deterministic drift detection are established.

families.core_pattern: Fine hashed CNXML text and attribute slots with explicit problem, solution, asset, and accessibility relations.
limitations: Reverse CNXML reconstruction was not proved.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Reverse CNXML reconstruction was not proved.

families.core_pattern: UUID/alias family catalog with explicit hint-only/no-answer states and exact legacy-locator checks.
limitations: All 432 segments are headings rather than reusable prose.
Retained micro-checkpoint history dominates the machinery.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not established in the audited entry.

families.core_pattern: Operational course catalog with executable mastery units, exercises, artifacts, and prerequisite routes.
families.learner_runtime_status: Learner use is demonstrated through learner QA.
families.reversible_exchange_status: No reversible/common exchange.

families.core_pattern: Compact stable-URN JSONL with lossless CSV and a public-safe projection that exactly omits English authority text.
demonstrated_strengths: Exact omission of English authority text.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Lossless JSONL/CSV exchange is established.

families.core_pattern: Rich incremental 10102-record graph with explicit translation states and a byte-preserved predecessor.
limitations: One inherited invalid deferred state prevents clean full-schema replay.
399020415 bytes across 948 files, including 910 evidence files.
families.learner_runtime_status: Learner delivery is PDF-only in the audited evidence.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Byte-preserved predecessor is established, but full schema replay is not clean.

families.core_pattern: One 3323-unit graph producing two nonduplicating course views with 6505 typed relations, persistent birth/current identities, source-frozen state, corrections, and deterministic self-contained exchange.
demonstrated_strengths: Two nonduplicating course views from one graph.
limitations: Course selectors are not exposed as distinct learner navigation.
Semantics rely on custom verifier code beyond the permissive envelope schema.
families.learner_runtime_status: Distinct course views exist, but their selectors are not exposed as distinct learner navigation.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Deterministic self-contained exchange is established.
recommended_reuse: one canonical graph with nonduplicating course views

families.core_pattern: Broad bilingual entity/event graph with concepts, prerequisites, corrections, rights, and many reversible projections.
demonstrated_strengths: Concept, prerequisite, correction, and rights coverage.
families.learner_runtime_status: A reader exists, but TeX rather than the backend drives it.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Many reversible projections are established.

families.core_pattern: Exact parallel source/target PreTeXt graphs with 19048 records and a strong concept/prerequisite model.
limitations: One queued mapping in the terminal release.
families.learner_runtime_status: Reader inventories are reported, but direct backend runtime consumption is not established.
families.reversible_exchange_status: High portability and determinism are established; exact reverse import is not separately stated.

families.core_pattern: A 722-module TeX source overlay with an exact 642-reader/80-retained-source distinction, frozen import closure, and complete evidence.
families.learner_runtime_status: No course navigation or HTML.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Preservation closure is established; normalized reversible semantic exchange is not.

families.core_pattern: Per-prompt statement/hint/answer/solution manifests and mastery modules consumed in a collapsible self-study reader.
demonstrated_strengths: One of the strongest learner-use proofs.
Direct consumption by a self-study reader.
families.learner_runtime_status: Direct learner runtime use is established through the collapsible self-study reader.
families.reversible_exchange_status: No clean global reversible graph.

families.core_pattern: Compact additive unit, exercise, hint, and figure catalogs directly consumed to build semantic HTML and EPUB.
limitations: Two-record/three-relation local-public catalog drift reduces reproducibility.
families.learner_runtime_status: Direct learner delivery through semantic HTML and EPUB is established.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not explicitly established; local-public catalog drift is present.

families.core_pattern: Tea Time backend with deterministic pack/merge, experiment records, exact toolchain receipts, one-byte drift rejection, and lossless open export.
limitations: Later helper-packet evidence must not replace this primary interpretation.
families.learner_runtime_status: No shared runtime is proved.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Lossless open export is established.

families.core_pattern: Paired source/target hashes, mastery triples, notebooks, and project packets; the manager adapter maps 4941 native records and reconstructs 81 files.
limitations: Earlier native validator coverage was incomplete.
Latest readable task boundary concerned a revoked helper.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not established in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: File reconstruction is demonstrated for 81 files, but universal portability is not established.

families.core_pattern: Complete locale-neutral graph with 1993 units, 5525 segments, 9545 relations, prerequisites, exercises, and executable lab adaptations.
demonstrated_strengths: One of the best general course models.
families.learner_runtime_status: Real reuse and executable labs are demonstrated; a shared live backend consumer is not explicitly stated.
families.reversible_exchange_status: No reverse importer.

families.core_pattern: Rights-separated federation of Penn spine, donor material, and original companion with staged problems, simulations, mastery metadata, and byte-identical cumulative reuse.
limitations: Prerequisites and objectives remain in Markdown rather than graph edges.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Byte-identical cumulative reuse is established; full reverse exchange is not explicitly stated.

families.core_pattern: Exact bilingual source-topology catalog with raw source/target TeX, hashes, rights, and deterministic JSONL/CSV replay.
limitations: Many empty projections and version chains.
Current backend exceeds the public release.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Deterministic JSONL/CSV replay is established.

families.core_pattern: Immutable scholarly base with an additive learner companion overlay, formula alignment, solutions, HTML routes, and accessible SVGs.
families.learner_runtime_status: Genuine learner use through HTML routes is established.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Not explicitly established in the audited entry.

families.core_pattern: Generic typed course graph joining donor sources, outcomes, labs, programs, assets, rights, and activities.
limitations: The site shares identifiers but does not consume the backend.
Exporter and artifact weight is high.
families.learner_runtime_status: The site shares identifiers but does not consume the backend.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Portability is strong; exact reverse exchange is not explicitly established.

families.core_pattern: Append-only TeX document graph with label-derived stable IDs and byte-identical predecessor prefixes/xref snapshots.
demonstrated_strengths: Byte-identical predecessor prefixes and xref snapshots.
limitations: Models topology rather than learning semantics.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Release-lineage identity is strong; formal reversible exchange is not established.

families.core_pattern: Append-only provenance topology distinguishing official answers, missing answers, original repairs, rights, corrections, and reader anchors.
limitations: Graph is dominated by QA, artifact, and order history.
families.learner_runtime_status: Reader anchors exist; direct backend runtime consumption is not reported.
families.reversible_exchange_status: A reproducible source package is established; exact reverse exchange is not explicitly stated.

families.core_pattern: Eleven typed locale-neutral JSONL streams covering concepts, hints, solutions, proofs, rights, and routes.
limitations: 566 correction rows create high synchronization cost.
Compact Zenodo archive alone is not a build tree.
families.learner_runtime_status: Learner routes are verified.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Interoperability is established; exact reverse reconstruction is not explicitly stated.

families.core_pattern: Component-sovereign Li, Duncan, CRing, and original backends federated by a real cross-component learner route.
limitations: Four PDFs rather than one integrated learner corpus.
families.learner_runtime_status: A real cross-component learner route exists, but delivery remains four PDFs rather than one integrated corpus.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Federation is demonstrated; dialect fragmentation prevents a clean common exchange claim.

families.core_pattern: Lean source-span, terminology, and alt-text ledgers whose alt descriptions are consumed by the HTML reader.
demonstrated_strengths: Alt descriptions consumed by the HTML reader.
families.learner_runtime_status: HTML reader consumption of alt descriptions is established.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Public replay is not self-contained.

families.core_pattern: Integrated course-object graph tying definitions, proofs, labs, assessments, solutions, and capstone to one stable identity.
demonstrated_strengths: Single stable identity across course objects.
families.learner_runtime_status: Real multi-format delivery is established; direct common-backend consumption is not explicitly stated.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Limited reversible/external reuse evidence.

families.core_pattern: Full 60-unit authority graph with a 19-unit learner route as a nonduplicating view, separating edition, release snapshot, and route.
families.learner_runtime_status: A 19-unit learner route exists as a nonduplicating view; the corpus is incomplete.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Terminal replay is incomplete.
recommended_reuse: authority graph plus nonduplicating learner views

families.core_pattern: Executable proof-aligned graph preserving Lean modules, declarations, and imports while localizing prose.
demonstrated_strengths: Compiler as a uniquely strong semantic replay oracle.
families.learner_runtime_status: Not reported in the audited entry.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Deterministic compiler-backed replay is established; general-purpose reversible exchange is not explicitly established.

families.core_pattern: Preserved content backend plus locale-neutral semantic/assessment wrapper, localized text, renderer locators, learner-claim state, explicit prerequisites, and immutable relations.
limitations: Parallel wrappers and ledgers make the design overbuilt.
families.learner_runtime_status: Accessible HTML exists, but there are zero live learner instances.
families.reversible_exchange_status: Reversibility is explicitly established.
